Phrase

Background listening (Android app · experimental)

Listen for “Hey Maya” with screen offRequires the Android app, microphone permission and a supported Android speech service. Start while the app is open. An ongoing notification shows when listening; tapping its Stop action ends it. When Maya hears your phrase, tap the notification to open her. This is not guaranteed 24/7 listening.

Messages (Android app only)

Notification accessAvailable in the Maya Android app only.
Tell me when a message arrivesMaya says who wrote. She reads the text only after you say yes. Messages stay in memory only and are never saved.

Chat & installed apps (Android app only)

Maya can read only supported Android message notifications after Notification Access is enabled. She cannot secretly read past chats. Quick Reply works only when a chat notification offers Reply. New messages open the chat app's share screen; you choose the recipient and tap Send.

Memory & privacy

Automatically remember durable factsTurn off to stop automatic AI memory updates. Manual memory editing still works.
Use saved memories in Gemini repliesOff means saved memories stay on your phone and are not included as memory context in new AI requests.

Profile backups exclude your Gemini API key. Save the JSON file privately. Your microphone audio, messages you send and other necessary request data still go to Gemini during active calls.
